BiblicalUsage: Mispar came with Zerubbabel, in the list of the men who returned: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. He is named once, among the first to come home from Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Mispar's place in the return list is honour enough: he came home with Zerubbabel, and his name stands among the builders of the second temple.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
